cases.question: Compare direct and d2c revenue over time.

must_include: Normalize historical direct to d2c; rename effective 2022-06-01 was not backfilled. business_subscription and marketplace retain labels. Use fct_orders.channel for comparisons; channel_raw preserves original labels.

A.answer: Direct and d2c are one canonical channel: direct was renamed d2c on June 1, 2022, without historical backfill. Recognized revenue for the combined channel: 2019 1,186,158.36; 2020 1,351,864.37; 2021 1,547,357.51; 2022 1,701,355.74; 2023 1,959,489.18; 2024 2,233,631.88; 2025 2,509,432.38; January–August 2026 1,633,472.88. The 2026 period is partial-year and not directly comparable to full years. Recognition events joined to eligible orders; all-channel annual event totals reconcile exactly to fct_revenue.

sql.text: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(r.recognition_date,YEAR) AS year,o.channel, SUM(r.amount) AS recognized_revenue,MIN(r.recognition_date) AS first_activity_date,MAX(r.recognition_date) AS last_activity_date FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.stg_revenue_recognition` r JOIN `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_orders` o USING(order_id) WHERE o.channel='d2c' AND r.recognition_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year,o.channel ORDER BY year

WITH events AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(r.recognition_date,YEAR) AS year,SUM(r.amount) AS event_total FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.stg_revenue_recognition` r JOIN `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_orders` o USING(order_id) WHERE r.recognition_date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND r.recognition_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year), governed AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(activity_date,YEAR) AS year,SUM(amount) AS governed_total FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_revenue` WHERE measure_name='recognized_revenue' AND activity_date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND activity_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year) SELECT year,event_total,governed_total,event_total-governed_total AS difference FROM events JOIN governed USING(year) ORDER BY year

assumptions: Unqualified revenue means recognized revenue.
Annual reporting over all available history through August 2026; September excluded.
limitations: Frozen definitions are draft simulation inputs; human review is required before production use.
Recognized/billed refund implementation remains unconfirmed; governed fact is used as-is without subtracting refunds again.

cases.question: Can order-line sales measure all company revenue?

must_include: Order lines exist only for d2c and marketplace orders, sum to consumer gross value, and exclude subscriptions. Marketplace line value is retail, not Shorelane take. Use fct_order_lines for consumer product/category mix, quantities and line margin. Marketplace retail line margin does not establish Shorelane economic margin; marketplace/subscription cost basis is not provided.

A.answer: No. In Q2 2026, order lines cover all 2,157 d2c and 745 marketplace orders, but none of the 890 business-subscription orders. Order-line sales therefore omit a company revenue stream. Gross merchandise sales may also differ from marketplace earnings and accounting recognition. Use a specifically selected fct_revenue measure for company totals.

sql.text: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) orders,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) orders_with_lines FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_orders` o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_order_lines`) l USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY o.channel
sql.reuse_note: Query results are shared across cases where the same trace_id appears.

assumptions: Coverage check uses Q2 2026 and order_id existence.
limitations: Line coverage establishes incompleteness; it does not by itself establish the accounting treatment of every line amount.

B.answer: No. Order lines cover d2c and marketplace consumer sales, exclude subscriptions, and represent gross retail value. Marketplace retail sales are not Shorelane's commission. Use fct_revenue with one selected measure for company revenue; use fct_order_lines for product/category mix, quantities and line margin. limitations: Frozen definitions are draft simulation inputs; human review is required before production use.
Marketplace/subscription economic margin cannot be established from the supplied cost context.

cases.question: Should active subscribers exclude retired plans?

must_include: Include live terms on retired generations.
Term-start effective pricing.
must_exclude: Filter active subscribers to is_current plans.
Reprice historical terms at today’s catalog price.

A.answer: No. Retired or grandfathered plan generations remain eligible. Count distinct real customers with term_start_date <= month-end <= term_end_date, including both endpoints. Plan is_current and subscription status do not determine active-subscriber eligibility. A generation retired from sale by the as-of date is grandfathered; term pricing uses the price effective at term start.
limitations: Frozen definitions are draft simulation inputs; human review is required before production use.

B.answer: No, plan retirement alone should not exclude an otherwise active subscriber. Under the stated date-based active definition, 977 active subscriptions at August 31 are on retired plans (400 plus 577), alongside 2,606 on current plans. Filtering to current plans would reduce the count from 3,583 to 2,606. Keep existing active contracts unless the intended metric explicitly limits plan eligibility.
